title: Courtyard massing study
summary: An original geometric architecture fixture showing two joined masses, a bounded facade-bay rhythm and one abstract scale figure without referencing a real building.

record.title: Courtyard massing study prompt
record.purpose: Provide a bounded architecture worked example with observable massing, facade rhythm and scale cue.
record.sourceText: A fictional two-volume courtyard building with four facade bays and one abstract scale figure.

prompt.positive: One fictional two-volume courtyard building, clear roof and facade massing, four differently proportioned openings, one abstract human-scale marker, restrained mineral palette, orthographic-like graphic clarity.
prompt.negative: No landmark likeness, no architect signature, no logo, no watermark, no external building reference.

subject: one fictional joined two-volume building mass
composition: facade elevation with a readable primary and secondary volume
environment: plain ground datum and one abstract scale marker
materials: flat mineral tones separated from window bays
